name: Zepto
description: Zepto is a quick-commerce grocery and essentials delivery app. Core flows observed: getting past a location-permission sheet on launch by confirming a saved address, searching for products from the home-screen search box, and reading prices from a product results grid where each card shows selling price, struck-through MRP, pack size, rating and an ADD button.

workflows.name: get_past_location_sheet_on_launch
workflows.steps: Step 1: Launch Zepto. If a 'Location permission is off' sheet blocks the home screen, do not tap 'Enable' (that starts a system permission flow); instead tap the saved address card under 'Select your address' (or 'See All'). Step 2: The 'Select Location' screen opens with the saved address already marked 'Selected'. Step 3: Tap the selected saved address card to confirm; the home screen loads with the delivery time and address in the top bar.

workflows.name: search_product_and_read_price
workflows.steps: Step 1: On the home screen tap the search box (rotating placeholder such as 'Search for "Rakhi"'). Step 2: On the search screen, type the full query including brand and pack size (e.g. 'yu coconut water 1 liter') into the input field and press enter. Step 3: Wait for the results grid to load; right after enter the screen may still show only the typed query with no results. Step 4: Read the price from the matching product card: each card shows the selling price in bold, struck-through MRP, a discount label, pack size (e.g. '1 pc (1 L)'), rating and an 'ADD' button. Match the exact pack size before recording the price.

workflows.name: compare_price_with_another_app
workflows.steps: Step 1: Complete the Zepto search and record the price from the correct product card before leaving the app. Step 2: Open the comparison app with open_app using its full package name (e.g. com.grofers.customerapp for Blinkit); opening by display name failed in exploration. Step 3: Run the same search there and compare prices.

nuances: On cold start a 'Location permission is off' bottom sheet blocks the home screen. The 'Enable' button under 'Use my Current Location' starts a system permission flow; tapping the saved address card under 'Select your address' bypasses the sheet because the address is already pre-selected.
Immediately after open_app the accessibility tree can still show the previous app's screen content; wait and re-observe before tapping anything.

After typing a query and pressing enter, results do not appear instantly — the screen may still show the search field with the typed query (and a 'Clipboard / Dismiss copied text' element). Wait and re-observe rather than concluding there are no results.

Search results mix 'Sponsored'/'Ad' tiles with organic products, and the same brand appears in several pack sizes (e.g. 200 ml, 1 L, pack of 6) at different prices — always check the pack-size line on the card.

Zepto screens report misleading activity names: the search and Select Location screens appear as 'com.zeptoconsumerapp.Conversation', and a '.DEFAULT' screen was seen exposing no labelled elements at all (WebView/canvas). Do not rely on the activity name to know which screen you are on.
The search screen keeps 'Recent searches' chips with a 'Clear' action, and the query field has an X to reset it; a cart pill at the bottom shows the current item count once anything is in the cart.
A 'SHOP & EARN Rewards' overlay (e.g. 'Get up to ₹50 cashback') can appear over the results grid and block interaction; dismiss it via its close control before reading or tapping product cards.
recommendations: Prefer confirming the saved address over enabling GPS to get past the launch location sheet quickly.
Include brand and pack size in the search query, and verify the size on the product card before reading the price.
Insert a wait after open_app and again after pressing enter in search before judging what is on screen.
For price-comparison tasks, record the Zepto price before switching apps, and launch the other app by its resolved package name rather than its display name.
If the exact variant is not visible in the first rows of results, scroll the grid — sponsored cards occupy the top positions.
If a rewards or cashback overlay covers the results, close it first so product cards and prices are tappable and readable.
